title: ICHRA adoption slowed by ACA exchange costs, instability
summary: Many employers are considering the coverage arrangements, but worries about the ACA marketplaces — including potentially high costs for workers — are making them hesitant to move forward, according to a survey.

title: This week in 5 numbers: Why some workers aren’t AI upskilling
summary: Here’s a roundup of numbers from the last week — including how many C-suite, CHRO and senior talent acquisition leaders think their leaders are “highly prepared” to lead AI adoption.

title: Philadelphia DEI officer alleges she was fired for reporting a Black worker’s harassment
summary: The officer also said she was forbidden to speak publicly about equity.

title: Nearly half of workers say they’d let AI negotiate their pay
summary: One-third of U.S. adults have already asked artificial intelligence about their salary, a raise, a bonus or how to negotiate, a recent report showed.

title: How much is hybrid workplace coordination costing companies?
summary: Navigating shifting schedules and coordinating in-person meetings may be creating friction, per a survey from an operations platform.

title: How companies are accidentally training future leaders to stay quiet
summary: Organizations that encourage employees to ask the questions AI can’t answer will thrive, writes SurveyMonkey’s CPO.

title: 1 in 4 dollars spent on AI goes to waste, report finds
summary: More than half of businesses lack a dedicated owner for artificial intelligence costs, which can lead to overspend, according to a Harness report.

title: SHRM’s insurance carrier says it’s not on the hook for $10M jury verdict
summary: The insurer sued SHRM Tuesday, alleging state law prohibits it from indemnifying the organization because the jury found intentional race discrimination.

title: Northwestern Mutual must fork over DEI data in EEOC probe of alleged failure to promote White worker
summary: The company unsuccessfully claimed that the agency’s information requests were overbroad and too indefinite, according to a Wisconsin federal judge.

title: HR often uses ChatGPT to complete non-HR tasks, according to OpenAI report
summary: AI can change the division of work within an organization by allowing users to perform tasks outside their typical roles, OpenAI said.
